text:
alice_support: Heads-up — ACME reported a spike of 502s right after our scheduled cert/key rotation at 03:00 UTC. Their SDK logs show: "certificate signature algorithm not supported". They say the failures are client-side TLS errors, not our 5xx from the app. :warning:

ben_infra: Ok grabbing their request id and haproxy logs. Can you paste the client error and which SDK/platform (java/netty, iOS, etc.)?

alice_support: Their stack: java 8 (OpenJDK 1.8.0_292) using okhttp. Customer sent this error from their prod agent: 
```
javax.net.ssl.SSLHandshakeException: General SSLEngine problem: certificate verify failed: certificate signature algorithm not supported
at sun.security.ssl.Alerts.getSSLException(Alerts.java:192) ...
```

carmen_sre: I pulled the edge fronting cert chain from our endpoint: ran `openssl s_client -connect acme-api.private.redwood:443 -servername acme.customer`. Server returns the leaf cert and intermediate. The leaf signature algorithm shows as `rsaEncryption` with signatureAlgorithm `sha256WithRSAEncryption` for previous cert but the rotated cert shows `rsaPss`/RSA-PSS signature. Older OpenJDK 1.8 builds don't handle RSA-PSS signed certs as a chain sig algorithm in some config.

dev_rotator: That's consistent with the rotator job. The CA we used for the reissue switched to our HSM default signing profile which now prefers RSA-PSS (that's our default for better security). We didn't explicitly set legacy fallback. Rotator_bot recorded job 2026-03-17T03:00:00Z -> issued new leaf signed with RSA-PSS.

alice_support: Customer is blocked, says they can't upgrade JDK immediately. Any quick mitigations?

ben_infra: Two paths: rollback to previous cert signed with PKCS#1 v1.5 (short term), or ask customer to enable a newer trust/cipher stack. For rollback we need to check if we still have the old key/cert in the rotator history and whether HSM allows re-signing with old profile.

carmen_sre: Repro steps for us:
1) `openssl s_client -connect acme-api.private.redwood:443 -servername acme.customer -showcerts`
2) Inspect `Signature Algorithm` lines for leaf and intermediate.
3) Try `java -jar tls-debug.jar` against host using their JDK build to replicate handshake error.

dev_rotator: I checked rotator history: we retained the prior cert (thumbprint abcdef1234) for 7 days. We can re-deploy that cert to the edge immediately as emergency rollback. Doing a rollback will reintroduce old private key (still in HSM) and the chain signed with SHA256-RSA (PKCS#1 v1.5).

alice_support: Customer asks for ETA. How long to rollback?

ben_infra: If ops approves, we can push the previous cert to the VPC proxy in ~15-30m. Need a quick change window to avoid partial rollout. Will coordinate with oncall.

carmen_sre: Quick diagnostic commands for ACME if they want to test locally before we touch infra:
```
# check signature alg
openssl x509 -in leaf.pem -noout -text | grep -i "Signature Algorithm"
# see chain as served
openssl s_client -connect acme-api.private.redwood:443 -servername acme.customer -showcerts
# test handshake with their JDK (from their host)
java -Djavax.net.debug=ssl,handshake -jar client-test.jar https://acme-api.private.redwood
```

dev_rotator: Action items: 
- I will prepare rollback to previous cert (rotator job id 78910) and mark as emergency if ops gives thumbs up.
- If rollback not allowed, we need a signed replacement with PKCS#1 v1.5 profile; request to CA team to reissue with legacy profile.
- Add a rotator flag to preserve signing algorithm parity for tenants flagged as "legacy" (follow-up RFC).

rotator_bot: rotator job 78910 archived cert thumbprint abcdef1234 available for redeploy.

alice_support: Noted. I've told ACME we'll aim for a rollback in 30m and to expect a maintenance window. Asked them to provide exact JVM build/release so we can validate. :thumbsup:

ben_infra: Oncall approves, I'll schedule the rollback and watch metrics. Will post back when deployed.

carmen_sre: After rollback we should issue a postmortem item: add signing-algo compatibility check in rotator preflight (reject rsa-pss for customers with legacy JVMs unless explicitly opted-in). Also ping CA/HSM team about having both signing profiles available as an explicit parameter.

alice_support: ACME replied with their JVM: OpenJDK 1.8.0_292-b10. They can't upgrade w/o product freeze. Confirming rollback now.

ben_infra: rollback done @ 2026-03-17T03:27:30Z. Monitoring now — initial 200s returned. Latency normal.

alice_support: ACME confirms calls succeed from their agents. They're back to green. 

carmen_sre: Root cause: rotator defaulted to RSA-PSS signing using HSM profile; legacy JVMs rejected RSA-PSS signed leafs during chain verification. Mitigation: rollback to PKCS#1 v1.5 signed cert + rotator change to preserve signing alg when tenant flagged legacy.

dev_rotator: I'll open an RFC and a small change PR to add a signing-algo override and a compatibility preflight check.

alice_support: Closing loop with ACME and creating support ticket summary. Will attach logs and the rotator job IDs. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
